descriptions.text: Dead code still bleeds. Aevo, formerly known as Ribbon Finance, took a $2.7 million hit on old vaults. A proxy admin vulnerability enabled a full oracle hijack, allowing the attacker to rig prices to infinity and drain the old contract in one atomic loop.

On December 14, Aevo announced that a vulnerability introduced during a smart contract upgrade led to an attack on the legacy Ribbon DOV vault on December 12, resulting in losses of approximately $2.7 million.
